hinge.definition: derive later as geometric boundary/joint axis between screen_lid and keyboard_base, not as a PartField cluster

notes: N=2 gives the cleanest semantic screen/base split, visually confirmed.
N=3 was investigated and REJECTED: bbox-extent evidence shows its third
cluster is a second large flat panel (base split into two slabs),
not a hinge fragment. All three N=3 clusters share ~full-object extent
in two of three dimensions, inconsistent with a small hinge bracket.
Hinge is not needed for contact (Gate C), since hand-object contact
occurs on screen_lid and keyboard_base surfaces, not the hinge itself.
